structured_output.title: Issuer short name added in cert-manager v1.18.0
structured_output.content: Your environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 (confirmed across multiple deployment sources) and will receive this feature upon upgrade to v1.18.0. The change adds `iss` as a short name for the `Issuer` resource type, improving kubectl usability. Your manifests show `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` resources in use, but do not explicitly enumerate whether `Issuer` resources are deployed. Inspect your manifests and cluster for any `Issuer` resources or verify whether your cert-manager configuration relies on this resource type.
